what: A circular mask centered on the top-left corner (outer 20% blurred) spreads over 1.7s power2.out. The dark (.45) 2px-blurred panel opens up to 70% and the text panel to 100%. On close, both fold back to 0 with the same length and curve. Links inside are clickable only while open

options.veil: Size (%) at which the blurred panel opens, default 70
options.size: Size at which the text panel opens (%), default 100
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Backdrop that darkens and blurs the background (optional — size and position set by the consumer)
options.[data-fx-part=close]: Close button (optional). You may send fx:open, fx:close or fx:toggle to the panel, and Esc also closes it
options.fx:state: The panel, when opening and closing { open } Floats up

note: The open button is often outside the panel (in the header), so send fx:open to the panel to open it. While closed, the text panel is inert so focus cannot enter.
